definitions.explanation: A wedding performed in a Shinto shrine before the gods, typically with the bride in a white kimono ({白無垢|しろむく}) and the groom in formal hakama. Features rituals such as the three-cup sake exchange ({三三九度|さんさんくど}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandparents had a Shinto wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げたい→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: She says she wants to have a Shinto wedding.

examples.japanese: {神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧や⟦{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}→結婚式場：30785_kekkonshikijou⟧⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神殿|しんでん}→神殿：18822_shinden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Shinto weddings are held at shrines or in shrine halls inside wedding venues.

notes:
Compound of {神前|しんぜん} (before the gods) + {式|しき} (ceremony). The modern Shinto wedding format dates only to around 1900; before that, weddings were home ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to hold a Shinto wedding
- {神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧: attire for a Shinto wedding
- {神前式|しんぜんしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三三九度|さんさんくど}: the three-cup sake ritual in a Shinto wedding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教会式|きょうかいしき}→教会式：28944_kyoukaishiki⟧: church wedding ceremony — Christian-style
- ⟦{人前式|じんぜんしき}→人前式：28945_jinzenshiki⟧: secular wedding ceremony — non-religious, performed before guests as witnesses
- {仏前式|ぶつぜんしき}: Buddhist wedding ceremony — much rarer
